text: 1、市场全天震荡分化，三大指数涨跌互现。煤炭板块集体走强，云煤能源2连板，郑州煤电、大有能源涨停。航运板块拉升，南京港、招商轮船、海通发展涨停。军工板块异动，亚星锚链、湖南天雁涨停。黄金股午后活跃，湖南黄金、莱绅通灵涨停。下跌方面，传媒、短剧概念调整，出版传媒、大晟文化跌停；数字货币概念下挫，翠微股份跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市超3500股飘绿，今日成交1.87万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.28%，深成指涨0.15%，创业板指跌0.14%。 2、板块概念方面，煤炭、航运、军工、贵金属等板块涨幅居前，游戏、传媒、短剧、数字货币等板块跌幅居前。 3、两市共172
text_en: 1. Markets diverged in choppy trading all day, with the three major indices mixed. Coal sector rallied collectively, with Yunmei Energy hitting two consecutive limit-ups, Zhengzhou Coal Industry and Dayou Energy hitting limit up. Shipping sector surged, with Nanjing Port, China Merchants Energy Shipping, and Haitian Development hitting limit up. Defense sector moved, with Yaxing Anchor Chain and Hunan Tianyan hitting limit up. Gold stocks were active in the afternoon, with Hunan Gold and Lyshen Tongling hitting limit up. On the downside, media and short-drama concepts adjusted, with Publishing Media and Dasheng Culture hitting limit down; digital currency concept fell, with Cuiwei Share hitting limit down. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with over 3,500 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets turning green; today's turnover was 1.87 trillion yuan. At close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.28%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.15%, and ChiNext fell 0.14%. 2.
